block_metrics.comparison_note: predicted: LeWM plan latent decoded by the structured decoder; real: simulator ground-truth state

candidate_selection.reconstruction_note: candidates outside the kept set cannot be reconstructed from this compact trace
candidate_selection.rule: sorted union of the elite indices and the systematic sample 0, 10, ..., 290 of the 300 candidates, per CEM iteration

semantics.decision_action_offsets: elementary action offsets at which this episode replans
semantics.elite_actions: actions of the elite candidates, (iteration, elite, horizon, action_dim)
semantics.elite_costs: costs of the elite candidates, (iteration, elite)
semantics.elite_terminal_latents: terminal latent of each elite candidate, (iteration, elite, latent_dim)
semantics.executed_action_indices: elementary action indices executed in this rollout, 0..49
semantics.executed_actions_normalized: normalized actions really sent to PushT, (budget, action_dim)
semantics.executed_actions_postprocessed: physical actions really sent to PushT, (budget, action_dim)
semantics.final_plan_actions: normalized actions of the selected plan (final CEM mean), (horizon, action_dim)
semantics.final_plan_cost: latent cost of the selected plan
semantics.final_plan_latents: latent rollout of the selected plan, (latent_time, latent_dim), index 0 is the context
semantics.goal_latent: latent of the goal image used by the cost
semantics.kept_candidate_actions: actions of the kept candidates, NaN padded
semantics.kept_candidate_costs: costs of the kept candidates, NaN padded
semantics.kept_candidate_counts: number of valid indices per iteration row
semantics.kept_candidate_indices: deterministic candidate indices kept per iteration, -1 padded
semantics.kept_terminal_latents: terminal latents of the kept candidates, NaN padded
semantics.mean_after: CEM mean after the update (elite mean), (iteration, horizon, action_dim)
semantics.mean_before: CEM mean before the iteration's distribution update, (iteration, horizon, action_dim)
semantics.real_latents: latents of the real frames at block boundaries, (latent_time, latent_dim), index 0 is the context
semantics.std_after: CEM standard deviation after the update (elite std, ddof=1)
semantics.std_before: CEM standard deviation before the update, (iteration, horizon, action_dim)

units.costs: official LeWM latent cost between predicted and goal embeddings (unitless)
units.latents: LeWM CLS-projector embeddings, latent_dim values per latent time
units.normalized_actions: model action space (z-scores of the dataset actions; WorldModelPolicy applies the inverse StandardScaler before sending actions to PushT)
units.postprocessed_actions: exact arrays returned by WorldModelPolicy to PushT (action space [-1, 1]^2)
units.time: elementary PushT actions (one environment step per action)
